description: Read a site's robots.txt and report, for 17 search and AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Bingbot, CCBot, Google-Extended and more), whether each may fetch the home page and an optional path, and which rule decides. Uses RFC 9309 matching. Works without an API key (limited per day).

path.description: Optional path to check as well, e.g. /blog/post. Defaults to the path in url.

url.description: Site or page address, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/pricing

name: check_robots
title: Check robots.txt for AI crawlers
